window_rule: different token ID, non-overlapping occurrence, gap 0..100 bp, directed focal->partner
minimum_training_rule_considered: at least 5 focal-context occurrences spanning at least 2 genomes
decision: Do not train an X+Y conditionalization model from the sparse 1,000-token sample. Preserve grammar-evolution hypothesis and acquire denser representation evidence later.
claim_boundary: This does not falsify compound grammar; it blocks a reliable model at this sample density.
